errorCodes.meaning: This agent has no mnemonic export guard — it is not running in TEE mode, or no KMS bootstrap created one. There is no window to report on, ever, on this deployment.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Response.description: The mnemonic export guard's current state. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/attestation/mnemonic-status/0.2#response.

alreadyExported.description: Whether the mnemonic has already been exported. Once true, no further export succeeds — the release is one-time.

entropyAvailable.description: Whether the guard still holds entropy. False on every boot after the first, since a VTA generates its seed only once.

windowActive.description: Whether the export window is currently open.

windowRemainingSeconds.description: Seconds remaining in the export window; 0 once it has expired or was never active.

Response.title: VTA Attestation — Mnemonic Status — response payload
